description: A Windows desktop showing three panels: a SQL query editor (Azure Data Studio or similar) with a database query on the left, a Microsoft Azure Portal browser window in the center showing a resources list, and a dark-themed documentation or notes panel on the right displaying API or database-related technical content.

A Windows desktop showing multiple applications: DBeaver (database IDE) with SQL code on the left, a Microsoft Azure portal browser window in the center with an API resource configuration dialog open, and what appears to be a dark-themed terminal or code editor on the right.

A Windows desktop showing three application windows: a code editor (VS Code) on the left displaying SQL queries with syntax highlighting, a browser window in the center showing an Azure DevOps wiki or documentation page, and what appears to be a dark-themed application panel on the right side.

A Windows desktop showing a split-screen layout with DBeaver database IDE on the left displaying a SQL query against an 'alt_tables' schema, and on the right a browser window open to an AWS RDS documentation page alongside what appears to be GPT-4 in a chat interface.

The screen shows a split view with VS Code on the left displaying SQL queries selecting from database tables, a web browser in the center showing an Azure DevOps or similar project management interface with a dark dropdown menu open, and what appears to be a terminal or chat panel on the right side.
